page.notes: The left-hand fragments belong to the neighbouring page and were left out. The "Verf." at the lower right is possibly a catchword (abbreviation of Versus) and is recorded as one. The opening mark before "Tanquam" in verse 18 is a decorated initial T, read here as T. Verse 18 is printed with "inflati" and "sunt" in italic, as set above.
